strategic_objective: Improve access to quality primary healthcare for communities in northern Tanzania
description: Community health systems strengthening including CHW training, health facility support and disease prevention

strategic_objective: Increase access to quality education and reduce school dropout rates
description: School infrastructure, teacher training, scholarship support and literacy programmes

strategic_objective: Strengthen economic agency and financial inclusion of women and girls
description: Vocational training, savings groups, microfinance linkages and market access for women entrepreneurs

strategic_objective: Build community adaptive capacity to climate change impacts
description: Climate smart agriculture, reforestation, water harvesting and disaster risk reduction

strategic_objective: Improve smallholder farmer productivity and market access
description: Improved seed distribution, extension services, irrigation support and farmer cooperative development

strategic_objective: Protect children from violence, abuse, exploitation and neglect
description: Community child protection committees, case management, psychosocial support and legal aid referral
